const.indexes: ephemeral-by-default; tracked only by explicit repository selection; never canonical records
const.index_freshness: caller clock, source revision, source digest and age of observation; rebuilding cannot refresh old evidence
const.deletion: review retention and security/legal holds before deleting records or raw evidence; no automatic deletion authority
const.migration: opt-in exact revision and digest; preview bounded paths/visibility; preserve IDs/history/old pins; opt-out stops collection without deleting records
const.authority: schema/structural review is not truth, health, remediation, publication, human approval or fleet adoption

const.hygiene: capability applicability, paths, privacy, retention, index-freshness and rollout policy
const.aether: canonical record specification, schema and authoring skill; no copied record schema
const.egolint: production declaration/record validation and normalized findings, not diagnosis truth
const.observatory: privacy-safe independent observation/projection; no remediation or absence-to-health inference
const.relay: reusable validation execution and allowlisted presentation; consumer owns publication
const.pace: reviewed reversible adoption proposals; no automatic fleet mandate
const.repository: applicability facts, access, record content, sensitivity, retention/holds, final review and publication

activation_gate.const: Explicit maintainer disposition and compatible eligible owner inputs before required enforcement; alpha.1 is report-only.
